title: Image diagnosis intake and local case history
changes: Rebuilt the plant diagnosis page as a structured case-intake workflow.
Added JPG/PNG/WEBP image selection and camera capture on supported mobile browsers.
Added client-side image downscaling to a maximum 1400px edge and JPEG compression before local save.
Added plant selection, affected part, symptom, severity, onset, and notes fields.
Added local diagnosis case history with timestamps and delete action.
Images and case details remain in browser localStorage; no external AI request is made.
not_included: No Gemini API integration or API key required in this release.
No disease certainty score or treatment/pesticide recommendations.
No cloud sync or cross-device backup.
safety: This release records observations only. It does not diagnose plant disease or prescribe fertilizers/pesticides.
